subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship an experimental Rovo Dev provider before Atlassian’s site-selection contract is authoritatively verified for the undocumented credits endpoint?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical code repair: accepting an inferred Cloud-ID transport would define a user-facing provider contract and credential-routing policy without authoritative protocol evidence.

options.title: Verify before merge
options.body: Keep the PR parked until an authoritative source or redacted entitled-account trace proves the billing-site request shape, then add a regression test for that contract.

options.title: Accept the experimental risk
options.body: Merge with explicit documentation that site-scoped and multi-site accounts may report an incorrect allowance or fail until Atlassian publishes the contract.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Leave this implementation unmerged until Atlassian exposes a stable supported usage API or the site-selection flow can be verified.

recommendation.title: Verify before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR parked until an authoritative source or redacted entitled-account trace proves the billing-site request shape, then add a regression test for that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person performed the recent provider hardening and explicitly identified the unresolved protocol and merge boundary.
